answers.text: I am finishing a BSc in International Business at Mannheim. My internship in corporate finance at an automotive supplier taught me the most: I updated a 13-week cash forecast for two business units and noticed that one unit's receivables were always later than the plan assumed. I proposed a simple adjustment and the finance lead used it in the next forecast. I want a Master in Management because I can build the numbers, but I have not yet learned how strategy decisions are made.
In the student consulting association I took on a lot of responsibility and the team really grew. It was a great experience and I learned a huge amount about leadership.
I do not know exactly how much the reminders improved payment. We did not track late fees before we started, so I have no baseline to compare with.
